description:

title: What If You Had to Tutor Your Crush?
tags: what if you had to tutor your crush
description:
Your crush is failing math with a 38, and the vice principal just made you her tutor. The rule: whatever she gets on the final, you get too. You have 30 days, eleven confiscated highlighters, and a heart that does embarrassing things every time she says your name. By the end, one of you fails. It's not the one you think.

Two questions for the comments:
1) What grade would your crush get with you as the tutor?
2) Would you put your own grade on the line for it, yes or no?

Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.

Real facts in this episode:

• A 2013 review of ten popular study techniques rated highlighting as low utility (Dunlosky et al.).
https://www.psychologicalscience.org/news/releases/which-study-strategies-make-the-grade.html

• The forgetting curve: Hermann Ebbinghaus timed how fast memorized lists left his head in the 1880s, and a 2015 study replicated it.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4492928/

• Testing yourself beats re-reading: a week later, students who recalled a passage remembered more than students who studied it again (Roediger & Karpicke, 2006).
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16507066/

• Students who expected to teach a lesson remembered more than students who expected a test (Nestojko et al., 2014).
https://source.washu.edu/2014/07/expecting-to-teach-enhances-learning-recall/

• Pupils widen when the brain is working hard (Kahneman & Beatty, 1966).
https://scilit.net/publications/efa74888e1cd9a0111c6eaa5fe08086d

• Writing about your worries for ten minutes before an exam improved scores for anxious students (Ramirez & Beilock, University of Chicago, 2011).
https://news.uchicago.edu/story/writing-about-worries-eases-anxiety-and-improves-test-performance

title: What If You Trained in SECRET for 90 Days for Your CRUSH?
tags: what if you trained for 90 days
description:
Your crush laughed when you slid down the rope in gym class. So you make a plan: 90 days, no gym, no money, no days off, and nobody can find out. Every night at 11 PM you hit your bedroom floor for push-ups, while a light in the window across the street goes off at exactly 11:04. On day 90 there's a rope, a bell, and the guy who dared you in front of everyone.

Two questions for the comments:
1) How many days could you train in secret without missing a single one?
2) Would you have told her about the training, or kept the secret until day 90?

Subscribe, and I'll see you on day 91.


Real facts in this episode:

• Push-ups can build as much muscle as the bench press when the effort is the same (Kikuchi & Nakazato, 2017, 8 weeks).
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29541130/

• Next-day soreness is not lactic acid. It comes from tiny tears in the muscle fibers and peaks 24 to 72 hours later.
https://www.houstonmethodist.org/blog/articles/2021/oct/is-lactic-acid-buildup-really-what-causes-muscle-soreness-after-a-workout/

• In the first weeks of training, most new strength comes from your nervous system, not from bigger muscles.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7892509/

• The biggest pulse of growth hormone comes shortly after you fall asleep, during the first deep sleep.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8627466/

• A new habit takes about 66 days on average to feel automatic (from 18 to 254), and missing one day does not ruin it (University College London).
https://www.ucl.ac.uk/news/2009/aug/how-long-does-it-take-form-habit

description:
You went fishing with your crush, the boat flipped, and you both sank. A mermaid saved you. Now you're trapped in a city at the bottom of the ocean, and the only thing keeping you alive is a bubble of air. The bubble is running out, and the mermaids have very strict rules about humans who have seen their kingdom.

• Every 10 meters underwater adds about one more atmosphere of pressure (NOAA).
https://oceanexplorer.noaa.gov/?p=1842

• About three out of four animals in the open ocean can make their own light (MBARI, 2017).
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5379559/
